endpoint: daemon (native server, baseUrl from the router config; spawned as `opencode serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 0` when no baseUrl is set)
notes: Daemon preset (providerId 'opencode-http-agent', modelPrefixes ['opencode-http-agent','opencode-go','opencode'], endpoint mode 'daemon', protocol openai-completions, route 'own', chatPath /chat/completions). The base URL is NOT a public host: it is resolved at runtime from the router's baseUrl setting, or by attaching to / spawning the local OpenCode server, so no fixed endpoint string is recorded here. models are the ENABLED routes measured in this repo (go/deepseek-v4.1-flash and go/minimax-m3.1-flash, the latter also being the declared default model); the served catalog is the live /api/model list, which also carries zen routes and other families, so this is a measured subset, not a fixed catalog — the ENABLED set is operator-controlled (enabledModels) and can differ per install. reasoning lists the VARIANT ID VOCABULARY a route can advertise (vendor/opencode/lib/shared.js VARIANT_ORDER), not a promise that every route offers all of them: effort is a per-route variant selected as `provider/model#<variant>`, a route with no variants advertises NO efforts, and the ids actually offered come from that route's own `/api/model` variant list — so this list is catalog-dependent, and the leading 'none' is a real selectable level here rather than an absence marker. UNVERIFIED / catalog-dependent: cache is true because the wire reports prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and the adapter can send cache_control markers, but whether a given route actually caches is not asserted; structuredOutput is true as a protocol capability and is NOT exercised by any vendored adapter here (no response_format is sent), so treat it as unproven for these routes; vision is true only for routes the catalog tags image-capable — the host's modality vocabulary is text|image, so audio/video/pdf are never advertised and an untagged route is text-only in the picker. Credentials come from the daemon control plane (GET /api/credential, oauth ranked before key) or an apiKey/OPENCODE_API_KEY; none is recorded here.
